pokemon_scp.name: Rhyhorn
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0111 is to be contained in a reinforced geological pen with shock-absorbent flooring. Personnel must avoid standing in SCP-0111’s charge path.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0111 is a quadrupedal organism with dermal plating composed of dense mineralized keratin. Capable of charging at high speeds and generating shockwaves upon impact.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive when startled. Displays territorial dominance and attempts to ram barriers.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0111-A: SCP-0111 fractured a reinforced wall during a charge.
Addendum 0111-B: Dermal plating shows crystalline growth patterns.

pokemon_scp.name: Rhydon
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0112 is to be contained in a titan-grade geological vault with seismic dampeners. Personnel must not enter during agitation cycles.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0112 possesses immense strength and can generate seismic shockwaves by stomping. Horn rotation allows drilling through reinforced concrete.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Highly aggressive. Shows awareness of structural weak points.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0112-A: SCP-0112 drilled through a containment barrier.
Addendum 0112-B: Seismic output exceeded safe thresholds during testing.

pokemon_scp.name: Chansey
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0113 is to be housed in a medical-grade containment suite. SCP-0113 may assist Foundation medical personnel under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0113 produces anomalous eggs capable of accelerating healing and stabilizing critical injuries. Egg composition shows regenerative compounds not found in nature.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Gentle and nurturing. Shows empathy toward injured personnel.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0113-A: SCP-0113’s egg healed a Class-IV burn in under 30 minutes.
Addendum 0113-B: SCP-0113 displays distress when exposed to suffering.

pokemon_scp.name: Tangela
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0114 is to be contained in a botanical enclosure with vine-resistant restraints. Personnel must avoid entanglement.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0114 is a vine-based organism composed of numerous animated tendrils. Vines regenerate rapidly when severed.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Curious and playful. Attempts to wrap around objects and personnel.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0114-A: Vine regeneration occurred in under 8 seconds.
Addendum 0114-B: SCP-0114 attempted to dismantle a containment camera.

pokemon_scp.name: Kangaskhan
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0115 is to be contained in a titan-grade mammalian vault. Personnel must avoid proximity to SCP-0115’s offspring.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0115 is a large marsupial organism with extreme physical strength. Displays heightened aggression when protecting its offspring.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Highly territorial. Offspring exhibits mild anomalous resilience.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0115-A: SCP-0115 broke a reinforced barrier during a protective rage event.
Addendum 0115-B: Offspring survived a fall that should have been fatal.

pokemon_scp.name: Horsea
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0116 is to be contained in a shallow aquatic enclosure with gentle currents. Personnel may interact with SCP-0116 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0116 is a small aquatic organism capable of producing ink clouds with mild adhesive properties. Displays rapid swimming ability.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Playful and curious. Uses ink clouds defensively.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0116-A: Ink cloud adhered to containment glass for several hours.
Addendum 0116-B: SCP-0116 created spiral-shaped water patterns.

pokemon_scp.name: Seadra
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0117 is to be contained in a deep aquatic vault with toxin scrubbers. Personnel must avoid exposure to SCP-0117’s spines.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0117 possesses venomous spines capable of delivering neurotoxins. Displays rapid directional swimming and hydrokinesis.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive when threatened. Uses spines to deter predators.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0117-A: Venom caused temporary paralysis in a researcher.
Addendum 0117-B: Hydrokinesis output increases during stress.

pokemon_scp.name: Goldeen
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0118 is to be contained in a shallow aquatic enclosure with reinforced glass. Personnel may interact with SCP-0118 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0118 is an aquatic organism with a hardened horn capable of piercing thin metal. Displays graceful swimming patterns.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Calm but reactive. Uses horn defensively.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0118-A: SCP-0118 pierced a containment panel during feeding.
Addendum 0118-B: Swimming patterns show rhythmic, wave-like formations.

pokemon_scp.name: Seaking
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0119 is to be contained in a reinforced aquatic vault. Personnel must avoid proximity to SCP-0119’s horn.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0119 possesses a powerful horn capable of penetrating reinforced barriers. Displays advanced hydrokinesis and territorial aggression.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive when disturbed. Uses horn to intimidate and attack.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0119-A: SCP-0119 shattered a reinforced barrier with a horn strike.
Addendum 0119-B: Hydrokinesis output increases during mating cycles.

pokemon_scp.name: Staryu
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0120 is to be contained in a shallow aquatic chamber with gem integrity monitoring. Personnel must avoid touching SCP-0120’s central core.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0120 is a star-shaped aquatic organism with a central gem that emits low-frequency pulses. Limbs regenerate rapidly when severed.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Silent and reactive. Moves toward light sources.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0120-A: Central gem pulse disrupted nearby sensors.
Addendum 0120-B: Limb regeneration occurred in under 6 minutes.
